nodes.label: User Icon SVG
nodes.description: A 24x24 white-filled SVG icon depicting a generic user/person. Features a circular head shape at the top and a curved body/shoulder silhouette at the bottom, representing a human figure. Designed as a single-path icon on a transparent background with white fill, suitable for use on dark or colored backgrounds. Commonly used in content management interfaces to represent a user profile, author attribution, or account identity.
